The '''Imperial Sector Urban Troopers''' were an organization within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. [[Ivhin Jayme]] was assigned to a [[Division/Legends|division]] of Imperial Sector Urban Troopers during his time in the army.<ref name="Ship Jackers">{{JournalCite|13|Special Ops: Ship Jackers}}</ref>
